noPay.title: Don't pay, don't send documents
noPay.body: Real jobs, shops and banks rarely ask for money or your passport first.

check.body: Paste the text or link, or add a screenshot.

jobs.title: Risky job offers and trafficking
jobs.hook: Overseas jobs with high pay, a border pickup, or a request to hand over your passport.
jobs.howItStarts: A post or message offers a job abroad with a big salary. No experience, no interview. Someone asks for a photo of your passport to book your place, then tells you to meet a driver.

signs.s1: Very high pay for easy work, and no experience needed.
signs.s2: Only a few places left. Leave this week.
signs.s3: A pickup at the border or airport, and no visa papers.
signs.s4: They want to keep your passport.
signs.s5: The recruiter has no company name and only uses a private chat app.

romance.title: Romance and investment
romance.hook: A friendly stranger who later pushes crypto or trading.
romance.howItStarts: A stranger writes to you by mistake and is kind. After days or weeks of chat, they say they make good money on a trading app. Then they invite you to try it with a small deposit.

signs.s1: A stranger says "wrong number" and then keeps chatting.
signs.s2: They show big profits from a trading or crypto app.
signs.s3: They send a link to an app you cannot find in the official store.
signs.s4: They ask for a deposit, or for crypto, to start.
signs.s5: They say the chance will close soon.

parcel.title: Parcel and bank messages
parcel.hook: "Pay a fee" or "verify your account" with a link.
parcel.howItStarts: A text says your parcel is held, or your bank account is locked. It has a short link and a deadline. The link opens a copy of a real site that asks for your card or login.

signs.s1: A small fee to release a parcel.
signs.s2: A short link or a web address that looks a little wrong.
signs.s3: Pay today or it will be returned. Verify now or lose access.
signs.s4: The sender is an unknown number, not your bank.
signs.s5: The same message was sent to many other people.

agency.title: Risky recruitment agencies
agency.howItStarts: A page says it is an official, licensed agency. It lists many jobs abroad. When you write to them, they ask for a registration fee, a training fee or a deposit before any contract.

signs.s1: No licence number, or one you cannot verify.
signs.s2: Fees for registration, training, visa or a "seat".
signs.s3: Every job pays well and needs no skills.
signs.s4: They tell you to pay today to keep your place.
signs.s5: Other workers have reported the same name or number.

shop.title: Risky online shop deals
shop.hook: Too-cheap deals, pay outside the app.
shop.howItStarts: You find a phone or a product at a very low price. The seller says "chat me for a better deal", and asks you to pay by bank transfer. After you pay, the seller goes quiet and nothing arrives.

signs.s1: The price is far below the normal price.
signs.s2: The seller asks you to pay outside the shop app.
signs.s3: A new seller account with no history or reviews.
signs.s5: The seller moves the chat to another app.

e1.title: You see a job post
e1.caption: A big salary, free flight and no experience needed.

e2.title: Tap the doll
e2.caption: The doll sees the post on your screen. It asks to open the hidden text.

e3.title: SafeRoute checks it
e3.caption: It reads the whole post and looks for the red flags.

e4.title: The result
e4.caption: SafeRoute shows a high-risk result, with the reasons and what to do next.

e1.title: A stranger starts a chat
e1.caption: Friendly words, then talk about easy profit.

e2.title: Tap the doll
e2.caption: SafeRoute needs the older messages to see the full story.

e3.title: Scroll up and tap again
e3.caption: The start of the chat shows a "wrong number" opening.

e4.title: The result
e4.caption: The chat shows signs of a romance and investment scam.

e1.title: A message arrives
e1.caption: SafeRoute warns you before you open the link.

e2.title: Tap to see why
e2.caption: You see the reasons. Do not open the link.

e1.title: You open an agency page
e1.caption: It says "official" and shows a licence number.

e2.title: SafeRoute checks it
e2.caption: It looks for the licence and for reports about the agency.

e1.title: You see a cheap deal
e1.caption: A phone for a fraction of its normal price.

e2.title: Tap the seller name
e2.caption: Ask SafeRoute to look at who is selling.

e3.title: Open the seller page
e3.caption: A new account with few sales.

e4.title: The result
e4.caption: SafeRoute shows the signs that make this deal look risky.

too_good.name: Too good
too_good.title: Too good to be true
too_good.explain: Pay or perks far above normal, with no experience needed.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.title: Pressure
pressure.explain: They want you to act fast and not think or ask anyone.
pressure.phrase: "Only 3 places left. Do not tell anyone."

payment_route.name: Odd payment
payment_route.title: Payment route
payment_route.explain: Fees, deposits or transfers before you start, or outside the app.
payment_route.phrase: "Send the fee to this account to book your seat."

identity.name: Hidden identity
identity.title: Hidden identity
identity.explain: No clear name or company. They only use private chat apps.

link_risk.name: Risky link
link_risk.title: Risky link
link_risk.explain: New web addresses, shortened links or look-alike tracking pages.

known_bad.name: Reported before
known_bad.title: Reported before
known_bad.explain: The number, page or script was already reported by others.

trafficking.name: Trafficking
trafficking.title: Trafficking signs
trafficking.explain: No visa, your passport is kept, or a pickup at the border.
trafficking.phrase: "A driver will meet you at the border. Bring your passport."

s1.title: Turn on the shield
s1.caption: A small Pyit Taing Htaung doll sits on the side of your screen.

s2.title: Tap it on anything strange
s2.caption: It works on posts, chats and shops in other apps.

s3.title: Read the result
s3.caption: Low risk, Be careful or High risk, with the reasons.
